name: Northstar Partners
short_description: Corporate finance advisory for founder-owned businesses.
description:
Northstar Partners advises founder-owned businesses through sale processes, management buyouts and minority investments.

The team works on a small number of mandates at a time and stays involved through completion rather than handing over to a delivery team.
pricing_text: Retainer plus success fee; quoted per mandate.
pros: Senior team stays on the deal;Sector focus rather than generalist coverage

name: Meridian Systems
description: Meridian Systems builds case-management and audit-trail software for organisations that have to evidence their processes to a regulator.
pricing_text: From €1,200 per month, banded by seat count.
pros: Audit trail is built in, not bolted on;Deploys into private cloud
cons: Setup takes weeks rather than days;No self-service tier

name: Oakridge Advisory
short_description: Operational due diligence for private equity.
description: Oakridge Advisory runs operational due diligence and post-deal improvement programmes for mid-market private equity funds.
pros: Works pre- and post-deal;Named team on every engagement

name: Arbor Works
description: Arbor Works manufactures engineered timber components to specification, mainly for construction and furniture supply chains.
cons: Minimum order applies to first-time customers

name: Calder Freight
description: Calder Freight runs regional distribution and bonded warehousing across the Benelux, with its own fleet rather than subcontracted capacity.

name: Fernwood Capital
description: Fernwood Capital invests in profitable industrial businesses, typically taking minority stakes and holding for longer than a standard fund cycle.
pros: Longer hold period than a standard fund

name: Halden Data
description: Halden Data builds and maintains data pipelines and reporting layers for companies that have outgrown spreadsheets but do not want an in-house platform team.
cons: Retainer model does not suit one-off projects

name: Ridgeline Studio
description: Ridgeline Studio designs interfaces for software with genuinely complex underlying models, where a conventional consumer design process does not transfer.
cons: Small studio; books up in advance

name: Thornbury Group
description: Thornbury Group places interim operations directors and programme leads into businesses going through a transition.

name: Wexford Analytics
short_description: Market analytics for industrial supply chains.
description: Wexford Analytics publishes pricing and capacity analysis for industrial supply chains.
